description: Indian market news and quotes without the scraping — offline-searchable and agent-native.

tools.name: articles_by_category
tools.description: News headlines within a category (e.g. business/markets, business/stocks, india, world). Required: category_path.

tools.name: articles_by_tag
tools.description: News headlines tagged to a stock or topic (e.g. reliance-industries, infosys, nifty). Required: slug.

tools.name: articles_get
tools.description: Full article page (title, description, and raw body HTML for goquery extraction). Required: slug.

params.name: slug
params.description: Full article path after /news/, e.g. 'india/tribunals-reforms-bill-2026-...-14001877' or 'business/markets/stock-market-live-updates-...-14000775'

tools.name: articles_latest
tools.description: Latest news headlines across all categories.

tools.name: indices_get
tools.description: Live quote for an Indian index. Required: key.

tools.name: stocks_quote
tools.description: Full NSE equity quote for a stock by its moneycontrol sc_id. Required: sc_id.

tools.name: trending_list
tools.description: Currently trending stocks on moneycontrol. Optional: limit (default: 10), classic (default: true).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of trending stocks to return.
